edges.evidence: both members of cluster:i18n-and-localization - locale-correct UI copy and locale-correct notification copy, the two halves of the app's PT/EN coverage.
both members of cluster:attendance-and-presence - the presence-mark model and the seat-count property it feeds into capacity/history views.
both members of cluster:auth-and-session - who you are and what you may access, the two halves of every authenticated request.
both members of cluster:coach-dashboard - the coach-facing dashboard surface and the role gate that decides who reaches coach-only surfaces at all.
both members of cluster:web-mobile-design-system - the shared token source and the platform-by-platform porting discipline built on top of it.
both members of cluster:invitation-and-eligibility-engine - the ranking/delivery engine and the hard admission gate it runs after.
both members of cluster:player-lifecycle-and-access - who owns a credential and who is authorized to act on a player's data.
both members of cluster:reminder-and-scheduling - the reminder state machine and the template-rendering guarantee every reminder it sends relies on.
both members of cluster:season-and-recurrence - the season boundary a recurring class must respect and the on-demand materialization of its occurrences.

secureTokenStorage implements the TokenStorage interface consumed by @levelup/api's initApi (client.ts) - a genuine cross-scope contract, not an import (mobile provides the adapter, packages defines the shape).

both implement the platform split of the same app-events SSE mechanism: packages/api/src/sse.ts provides buildEventsUrl, which mobile's sse.ts consumes with a react-native-sse client plus AppState-driven reconnect, the native counterpart to web's DOM EventSource usage.

playwright.config.ts's webServer array boots the Flask backend via `flask run` from a relative ../../../backend path, invoking the same create_app() entrypoint app.py wires for local dev - E2E infra coupling across scopes, not a source import.
editor.ts's api.get/post/patch/delete calls against /editor/<model>... match editor_api.py's Blueprint("editor_api", url_prefix="/api/editor") - an HTTP contract pairing, not a source import.

seasons.ts's raw calls to /app/seasons, /app/add_seasons, /app/delete/season are the client half of season_service.py's server-side season CRUD, routed through frontend_api.py; no @levelup/api resource module mediates this pair, unlike every other domain.

launch-loader.tsx's own docstring states it is the web half of the launch animation that already ships on iOS; both descend from the same design export (LA-slash-split-icon.html) and are kept geometrically identical with no import relationship.
mobile's EventCard is the cross-platform port of this file's role - the single card rendered for every class/event/block on the calendar - per the mobile-web parity work; no import relationship.

mobile's doc comment states it is a mobile port of web's CourtDiagramEditor.tsx; geometry constants (COURT_W/COURT_H/SERVICE_LINE) are stated to MUST match exactly since diagrams are shared data across platforms.

same cva variant naming for the same status-chip role, but a documented divergence: mobile uses rounded-full while web's source comment explicitly reserves full pills for filter controls, not status chips.

both files define the identical cva variant set (default/destructive/outline/secondary/ghost/link) crossed with the identical size set, read directly in both sources - mobile's ui/* primitives are a react-native-reusables port of web's shadcn/ui-based components.

same compound-component shape (Card/CardHeader/CardTitle/CardDescription/CardContent/CardFooter), but a documented divergence: mobile applies shadow-sm while web's source comment explicitly forbids shadows on cards.
occupancy-bar.tsx's comment and button.tsx's comment both independently restate the same LevApp rule set (motion/hover/status-color conventions) without importing or referencing each other.
both implement the same toast-notification concern via two entirely separate libraries (sonner vs @radix-ui/react-toast); neither imports the other.
